name: GA / Store Deploy Decision Gate
versionLane: 1.8.30 unless explicitly incremented by a separate release decision

defaultDecision.reason: PASS230 is an evidence gate. The default source-side packet blocks public GA, Store submission, broad installer push, and direct-download trusted-signing claims until manual proof artifacts and external approvals are attached outside source.

requiredGateEvidence.title: Full UX Hardening Gate
mustProve: maximized window chrome and content budget
one-click More Tools, Mission, Settings, Guide/KB, DevOps, IT Tools
Mission Control 1-Up, 2-Up, Tri-view, Quad, and Focus Pane restore

requiredGateEvidence.title: Enterprise Security and Data Gate
mustProve: mission import fuzz and validation hardening

requiredGateEvidence.title: Release Evidence Gate
mustProve: Windows Store MSIX build lane readiness
MSIX manifest and Store identity readiness
Microsoft Store listing and submission packet readiness
no generated installers, packages, signing files, or Partner Center credentials committed

requiredGateEvidence.title: External Distribution and Signing Gate
mustProve: Partner Center package identity reserved outside source before Store submission
MSIX upload generated outside source only when tooling is available
Microsoft Store review result tracked outside source
direct MSI/EXE/MSIX signing path documented separately if used
public copy does not claim signed direct-download packages unless trusted signing is actually complete

manualEvidenceChecklist: Fresh installed Windows smoke evidence attached outside source
Fresh installed Linux package smoke evidence attached outside source
Support bundle generated from installed app and reviewed for redaction
SBOM, checksums, release manifest, and package hashes attached outside source
Privacy, support, security, known issues, and code signing pages live
Store screenshots use sanitized demo data only
Partner Center identity and package upload handled outside source
Direct-download signing status is accurately described
Known blockers either resolved or explicitly documented with mitigation

allowedWhenAllEvidencePasses.directDownloadTrustedSigningClaimAllowed: only if the direct-download package is actually signed by a trusted signing path
